name: U_mean
source: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis FRED, U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics
transformation: Annual mean unemployment rate divided by 100, averaged over anchor period.
source_notes: Direct empirical anchor for the model unemployment moment. Weight retained to prevent local adoption/growth refinements from worsening unemployment fit.

name: Y_growth
source: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis FRED, U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis
transformation: Annual log difference in real GDP, averaged over anchor period.
source_notes: Direct empirical anchor for real output growth. Weight retained because output growth remained above the historical anchor.

name: Debt_to_GDP_final
source: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis FRED
transformation: Final available debt-to-GDP observation divided by 100.
source_notes: Preferred fiscal calibration target because the model reports debt on a ratio scale.

name: Ineq_all_workers_mean
transformation: Latest available national ACS Gini coefficient.
source_notes: Alternative inequality calibration target using all-worker current labor-income Gini in the model. Unemployed workers are assigned zero current labor income. This is closer to an income-distribution target than employed-only wage Gini but remains a labor-income proxy rather than household income.

name: Adopt_final
source: Federal Reserve FEDS Notes summary of Census BTOS
transformation: Year-end 2025 firm-weighted AI adoption share reported as about 18 percent.
source_notes: Publicly documented point estimate, not directly downloaded from the BTOS microdata. Weight retained because terminal adoption remained above the empirical anchor.

name: Ineq_mean
transformation: Latest available national ACS Gini coefficient.
source_notes: Hold-out diagnostic for the employed-worker wage Gini. This row does not enter the MSM loss in this target variant.

name: W_mean
transformation: Real hourly earnings index normalized to the first available anchor year.
source_notes: Hold-out validation target because model wages are normalized units.

name: Firm_exits_mean
source: U.S. Census Bureau Business Dynamics Statistics
transformation: Firm exits divided by firm count, averaged over available anchor years.
source_notes: Hold-out validation target because model exits depend on simulation scale.
